1.name: The Arcane Grimoire
1.description: An ancient spellbook writes a new page.
1.prompt: Read the book on your TBR the longest.
1.reward: Temp buff: Long Read Focus (+10 Ink Drops on your next completed book).

2.name: The Blood Fury Tattoo
2.description: Inked markings blaze across your skin.
2.prompt: Read a book featuring a counter culture rebellion.

3.name: The Bag of Holding
3.description: A battered satchel yawns impossibly wide.
3.prompt: Read a story with multiple POVs.

4.name: The Wandering Merchant's Request
4.description: A traveler draped in scarves greets you.
4.prompt: Read a book featuring a journey.

5.name: The Glimmering Pools' Gift
5.description: A nymph rises from glowing waters.
5.reward: Roll a die: on even gain an Amulet of Duality; on odd gain one Worn Page curse.

6.name: The Chime of Opening
6.description: A silver chime hums with anticipation.
6.prompt: Read a book where a long-hidden truth is revealed.
6.reward: Receive a Key of the Archive.

7.name: The Scarecrow's Cornfield
7.description: Rustling stalks and a grim figure loom.
7.prompt: Read a book with an unreliable narrator.
7.reward: Temp buff: Disjointed Perception (+10 Ink Drops, +5 Page Scraps).

8.name: The Empty Shelf
8.description: A hollow space on the stacks calls out.
8.prompt: Choose a book from your TBR you are most excited for.

9.name: Haggler's Row
9.description: The stallkeepers know your face by now, and not one of them will take full price from a Keeper.
9.prompt: Read a book you borrowed — a library copy, a friend's shelf, an app hold, an interlibrary request.
9.reward: Receive The Haggler's Ledger. +10 Dusty Blueprints.

branches.name: The Loan
branches.prompt: Read a book you borrowed — a library copy, a friend's shelf, an app hold, an interlibrary request.
branches.reward: Receive The Haggler's Ledger. +10 Dusty Blueprints.

branches.name: The Second Hand
branches.prompt: Read a book you bought used — thrift store, used bookshop, library sale, a reseller.
branches.reward: Receive The Haggler's Ledger. +15 Dusty Blueprints.

branches.name: The Gift
branches.prompt: Read a book you neither chose nor paid for — given to you, a Little Free Library find, a subscription box pick you'd never have bought. (Books that came with the house belong to the Lending Cart, not here.)
branches.reward: Receive The Haggler's Ledger. +20 Dusty Blueprints.

10.name: The Blind Stall
10.description: The merchant at the end of the ninth row sells her books wrapped in butcher's paper and string.
10.prompt: Pick a book from its title only. No blurb, no cover, no reviews, no one's opinion. Commit before you look at anything else.
10.rollInstruction: Roll a d6 to see which parcel she puts in your hands:

branches.name: Sold by title alone
branches.prompt: Pick a book from its title only. No blurb, no cover, no reviews, no one's opinion. Commit before you look at anything else.

branches.name: Sold by the spine
branches.prompt: Stand at a shelf — yours, a store's, a library's — and choose a book touching nothing but spines. No pulling it out to read the back first.

branches.name: Sold by the first line
branches.prompt: Read the opening sentence of a book and nothing else — not the blurb, not the cover copy, not the second sentence. Commit or walk away on that one line.

branches.name: Sold in a lot
branches.prompt: She won't split the bundle. Read two short works by the same author, or a book plus its companion novella.

11.name: The Masked Procession
11.description: At the gate they hand you a mask and take your name for the evening. Until the lanterns burn out you are permitted to be someone you are not, and expected to try.
11.prompt: Read in a genre you actively avoid or have simply never tried. Not a genre you read rarely — one you've decided isn't for you.

branches.name: The Stranger's Face
branches.prompt: Read in a genre you actively avoid or have simply never tried. Not a genre you read rarely — one you've decided isn't for you.

branches.name: The Other Life
branches.prompt: Read a book whose narrator's ordinary day has nothing in common with yours — different work, different body, different century, different belief about what a day is for.
branches.reward: Receive The Reveler's Mask. +20 XP, +5 Paper Scraps.

branches.name: The Opposing Voice
branches.prompt: Read a book that argues for something you're inclined to disagree with — fiction or non-fiction — and log one thing it got right.

12.name: The Communal Table
12.description: One table runs the length of the square, end to end. Nobody eats alone at the Festival of Turning — that is the entire body of festival law, and it is enforced by grandmothers.
12.prompt: Buddy read: read a book at the same time as someone else and talk to them about it at least once before either of you finishes.
12.rollInstruction: Choose your seat, or roll a d3 and let the table seat you:

branches.name: The shared plate
branches.prompt: Buddy read: read a book at the same time as someone else and talk to them about it at least once before either of you finishes.

branches.name: The long meal
branches.prompt: Read a book aloud to someone, or be read to — a partner, a child, a friend on a call. Any length counts; a picture book counts.

branches.name: The recipe
branches.prompt: Read a book with a meal at its center, then cook or make something that actually appears in it.

13.name: The Visiting Scholar
13.description: You are enrolled under a name nobody here can pronounce, in a hall where your expertise counts for nothing. Your first assignment is to stop being the most knowledgeable person in the room.
13.prompt: Read a book translated into your language, and name the translator in your log. They wrote every word you actually read.
13.reward: Receive the Visiting Scholar's Sigil. +20 XP.

branches.name: In translation
branches.prompt: Read a book translated into your language, and name the translator in your log. They wrote every word you actually read.
branches.reward: Receive the Visiting Scholar's Sigil. +20 XP.

branches.name: Enrollment record
branches.prompt: Read a book by an author from a country you have never read a book from — and strike that country off the Exchange's register. Each country can be claimed once, ever.
branches.reward: Receive the Visiting Scholar's Sigil. +25 XP, +5 Paper Scraps.

branches.name: The untranslated
branches.prompt: Read a book that leaves words from another language standing in the text — italicised terms, a glossary, an untranslated song, dialect the author refuses to gloss. Log three words you learned.
branches.reward: Receive the Visiting Scholar's Sigil. +20 XP, +10 Paper Scraps.

14.name: The Field Practicum
14.description: The Exchange grades on output, not on hours. Reading is the prerequisite for the coursework here, not the coursework itself.
14.prompt: Read anything, then teach one idea out of it to another person, out loud, for five minutes. They're allowed to ask questions. You're not allowed to read from the book.
14.rollInstruction: Roll a d4 for your assignment, or petition the registrar and choose:

branches.name: The lecture
branches.prompt: Read anything, then teach one idea out of it to another person, out loud, for five minutes. They're allowed to ask questions. You're not allowed to read from the book.

branches.name: The practicum
branches.prompt: Read something and then do it — cook the dish, walk the route, try the craft, run the drill, plant the thing.

branches.name: The seminar
branches.prompt: Read two books that disagree about the same subject, and write a paragraph on exactly where they part ways.

branches.name: The primary source
branches.prompt: Read a diary, collected letters, an oral history, or first-hand testimony from someone who was there. Not memoir — the Philosophy Alcove already takes memoir. This is unshaped material: documents rather than a narrative built out of them.

stake.name: Credit transfer
stake.condition: assignment output logged as a journal entry

15.name: The Crossroads Inn
15.description: Four roads, one hearth, and a house rule the innkeeper enforces with a broom: you eat what you're served and you read what you're handed.
15.prompt: She asks what you usually drink, listens carefully, and pours something else. Ask a bookseller or librarian to pick for you — in person or by note — and read whatever they hand over.

branches.name: The Bartender
branches.prompt: She asks what you usually drink, listens carefully, and pours something else. Ask a bookseller or librarian to pick for you — in person or by note — and read whatever they hand over.

branches.name: The Server
branches.prompt: He brings what the kitchen sent out; nobody consulted you. Read a book pressed on you by a stranger whose taste you have no reason to trust — a shelf card, a note left inside a used copy, a list you stumbled into.
branches.reward: Receive The Crossroads Fox. +20 XP, +5 Paper Scraps.

branches.name: The Regular
branches.prompt: Same stool, same story, every single time you come through. Read a book someone you know keeps recommending — the one they can't stop talking about.

16.name: The Short Crossing
16.description: The ferry runs the narrows in well under an hour. Whatever you brought needs to be finished before the far bank.
16.prompt: A collection, a chapbook, or a novel in verse.
16.rollInstruction: Roll a d4 for what's in your coat pocket:

branches.name: Poetry
branches.prompt: A collection, a chapbook, or a novel in verse.

branches.name: Illustrated
branches.prompt: A graphic novel, comic, manga, or an illustrated edition where the pictures are doing real work.

branches.name: Short form
branches.prompt: A short story collection, an essay collection, or a novella.

branches.name: Spoken
branches.prompt: A full-cast audiobook, or one read by the author.

stake.name: Crossing twice
stake.condition: two different rolls in the same month

17.name: The Lending Cart
17.description: A cart pulled between towns by a man who will not say where he got any of it. Every copy on it has somebody else's fingerprints somewhere in the pages.
17.prompt: Read a copy that is physically damaged, ex-library, or heavily marked by a previous reader — and log one thing that reader left behind. A note, a receipt, a name, an underline you disagree with.
17.reward: Receive The Mender's Thread. +25 Dusty Blueprints.

branches.name: The mender's fee
branches.prompt: Read a copy that is physically damaged, ex-library, or heavily marked by a previous reader — and log one thing that reader left behind. A note, a receipt, a name, an underline you disagree with.
branches.reward: Receive The Mender's Thread. +25 Dusty Blueprints.

branches.name: The re-read
branches.prompt: Re-read a book you loved at least five years ago, and log one thing you noticed this time that you missed then. The previous reader is you.
branches.reward: Receive The Mender's Thread. +15 Dusty Blueprints, +10 Paper Scraps.

branches.name: The inheritance
branches.prompt: Read a book that came into your home attached to someone else — a partner's, a parent's, a housemate's, or one that was already on the shelf when you moved in.
branches.reward: Receive The Mender's Thread. +20 Dusty Blueprints.

18.name: The Relay House
18.description: A staging post where letters wait for riders. The postmaster will carry absolutely anything, provided it is addressed to somebody.
18.prompt: Read an epistolary novel, or a book told through documents, transcripts, case files, or found records.

branches.name: Letters received
branches.prompt: Read an epistolary novel, or a book told through documents, transcripts, case files, or found records.

branches.name: Letters sent
branches.prompt: Read anything, then write to someone about it — an actual letter, a long message, a review posted where strangers can read it.

branches.name: Letters left
branches.prompt: Read a book and leave something in it for whoever reads it next — an annotation, a pressed note, a copy handed on with a message tucked inside.
